answer:
Below is a concise snapshot of the companies that **won a BATR (British Association of Toy Retailers) Toy Award in the 1997/98 cycle** and the current status of those businesses as of 2024.  
Only the companies that **no longer exist as an independent entity before 2020 – or that have been bought out and now operate under a different name –** are highlighted; the rest remain active under their original brands.

| Category (1997/98 BATR Award) | Award‑Winning Product | Company / Brand that produced it | Current Status (2024) | Notes |
|------------------------------|------------------------|----------------------------------|---------------------|-------|
| **BATR Toy of the Year** | *Teletubbies* | BBC Television / BBC Children’s BBC | **Active** | Still producing new Teletubbies content and merchandise. |
| **Most Innovative Toy** | *Tamagotchi* | Bandai | **Active** (now part of Bandai Namco Holdings) | Bandai merged into Bandai Namco but keeps the Bandai brand. |
| **Nano Pals** | *Nano Pals* | Playmates Toys | **Active** | Playmates remains a toy manufacturer; “Nano Pals” is still sold under that label. |
| **Barcode Truck** | *Barcode Truck* | *Unknown small‑toy firm* | **Defunct / No successor** | No contemporary manufacturer or licensing partner; the brand has not survived past the late‑1990s. |
| **Game of the Year** | *Star Wars Monopoly* | Waddingtons | **Acquired & re‑branded** | Purchased by the French firm **Asmodee Group** (2014‑15). The Waddingtons brand was folded into Asmodee; the game is now marketed under Asmodee. |
| **Game of the Year** | *Jenga* | MB Games | **Defunct / absorbed** | MB Games ceased operating as an independent entity. The Jenga brand is now owned by **Hasbro (CBG)** and no longer carried the MB Games name. |
| **Game of the Year** | *Goosebumps* | Waddingtons | **Acquired & re‑branded** | Same outcome as Star Wars Monopoly – now under Asmodee. |
| **Boys Toy of the Year** | *Action Man* | Hasbro | **Active** | Hasbro continues to produce Action Man toys under its own brand. |

### Companies that **are not operating under their original names before 2020** (or are effectively defunct)

| Company | Reason it no longer exists as originally owned/named |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Waddingtons** | Acquired by Asmodee Group in 2014‑15; the independent Waddingtons brand ceased. |
| **MB Games** | Dissolved; the Jenga brand was transferred to Hasbro, which describes it under the CBG portfolio. |
| **Barcode Truck** (small‑toy firm) | No surviving manufacturer or licensing partner; the brand has been inactive since the late‑1990s. |

### Companies that **remained in business under their original names** (pre‑2020 and beyond)

* BBC Television / BBC Children’s BBC  
* Bandai (now part of Bandai Namco Holdings but still sells under “Bandai”)  
* Playmates Toys  
* Hasbro

---

**Bottom line:**  
Of the award‑winning companies from the 1997/98 BATR Toy Awards, the only ones that had either gone out of business or been absorbed into a larger corporate umbrella and lost their original brand identity before 2020 were **Waddingtons, MB Games, and the small‑toy firm behind Barcode Truck**. All other winners continue to operate under their historic names.
